##### **About Company**


Arcitech AI, located in Navi Mumbai's bustling Vashi, is a trailblazer in software and IT, specializing in software development, AI, mobile apps, and integrative solutions. Committed to excellence and innovation, Arcitech AI offers incredible growth opportunities for team members. Enjoy unique perks like weekends off and a provident fund. Our vibrant culture is friendly and cooperative, fostering a dynamic work environment that inspires creativity and forward\-thinking. Join us to shape the future of technology.


Unit No. 15, Ground Floor, E Wing, Phase \- I, Akshar Business Park, Sector \- 25, Vashi\- 400703\.


##### **Job Description**


**ARCITECH AI**
===============


UI/UX Designer Intern


Design \| Vashi, Navi Mumbai (On\-site) \| 3\-Month Internship


**INTERNSHIP STRUCTURE**
------------------------


Duration: 3 months, on\-site.


Conversion: Performance during the internship is reviewed at the end of the term. Strong performers are


converted to a full\-time role at Arcitech AI; this is not automatic and is assessed against the same bar as our


full\-time hires for this function.


Prior project experience (academic, personal, freelance, hackathon, or open\-source) directly relevant to this


role is required to be considered — we are not hiring purely on academic credentials with no applied work to


show.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


Arcitech AI is looking for a UI/UX Designer Intern to join our in\-house design team, working in Figma


alongside our senior product designers across our SaaS portfolio. You will get exposure to both UX (flows,


research, IA) and UI (visual craft, design systems), on real product surfaces. Strong performers over the 3\-


month term will be considered for a full\-time UI/UX Designer role.


You should already be comfortable designing in Figma and have at least one design project — a personal


case study, a college project, or freelance work — that shows real design thinking, not just visual polish. We


will build your product\-design depth on the job; we expect the tool fluency and design instincts already in


place.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Assist in designing wireframes, flows, and high\-fidelity screens in Figma, under the guidance of a senior


designer.


* Contribute to and follow our existing design systems and component libraries — learning consistency


across a product portfolio, not just single screens.


* Support basic user research and usability observations, and help translate findings into design


decisions.


* Prepare clean, organized design files for developer handoff and learn to reason about front\-end


constraints (components, responsive behavior).


* Get exposure to designing for AI\-driven product surfaces — chat interfaces, loading/uncertainty states,


and similar.


* Present and defend your design decisions in reviews with senior designers.


* Own the design of one small feature or screen end\-to\-end during the internship, as a basis for your


conversion evaluation.


**Qualifications**
------------------


* Pursuing or completed a Bachelor\&\#39;s degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, or a related field (or


equivalent demonstrated skill).


* 0–1 years of professional experience — internships, coursework, and self\-driven projects all count.


* Mandatory: a Figma portfolio with at least one real UI/UX project you can walk us through — personal,


academic, freelance, or a structured case study. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.


**Skills**
----------


* Working knowledge of Figma — frames, components, basic auto\-layout.


* Basic understanding of UX fundamentals — user flows, wireframing, information architecture.


* An eye for visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, and layout.


* Willingness to take and act on design critique.


* Curiosity about how designs get built — basic awareness of front\-end constraints is a plus.


* Clear communication — able to explain the thinking behind your design choices, not just the visuals.


**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Exposure to AI design tools (Figma AI, Uizard, or similar).


* Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS.


* Any exposure to designing for SaaS, dashboards, or B2B products.


Other Details


This is a 3\-month, on\-site internship based at our Vashi, Navi Mumbai office. You will be mentored directly by


our senior product design team.


Please include a link to your Figma portfolio with your application — this is required for shortlisting;


applications without one will not be reviewed.


Performance is evaluated on design thinking, craft, and how you respond to review feedback, not just screens


produced.

title: Architect Designer
description:
**Full job description**

**Job Summary:**

Architects design buildings and other structures, ensuring they are functional, safe, sustainable, and aesthetically pleasing. They work closely with clients, engineers, and construction teams throughout the design and construction process.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Ø **Design Development:** Create architectural designs that meet client specifications and project requirements.

Ø **Project Planning:** Develop and oversee project timelines, budgets, and milestones.

Ø **Technical Drawings:** Produce detailed drawings and specifications using computer\-aided design (CAD) software.

Ø **Building Codes and Regulations**: Ensure designs comply with local building codes, zoning laws, and safety regulations.

Ø **Client Interaction:** Meet with clients to understand their needs, present design ideas, and make revisions based on feedback.

Ø **Collaboration:** Work alongside engineers, interior designers, and construction professionals to ensure seamless project execution.

Ø **Site Visits:** Conduct site assessments to monitor progress and resolve any issues that arise during construction.

Ø **Sustainability Practices:** Incorporate sustainable design principles and materials to minimize environmental impact.

Ø **Research and Innovation:** Stay updated on industry trends, new materials, and design technologies.

**Qualifications:**

Ø **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture from an accredited program.

Ø **Licensure:** Professional licensure as an architect (typically requires passing the Architect Registration Examination).

Ø **Experience:** Relevant experience in architectural design, project management, and client interaction.

Ø **Skills:** Proficiency in design software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp), strong communication, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.

**Work Environment:**

Architects typically work in an office setting but may also spend time on construction sites. They often work full\-time, with some overtime required to meet project deadlines.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Job Summary

Bajaj Finserv is looking for an experienced **Lead Product Designer** to drive end\-to\-end product design for high\-traffic B2C digital products across web and mobile platforms.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **Product Design, UX, UI, design systems, user research, prototyping, and usability testing**, along with the ability to work closely with Product, Engineering, Business, and Research teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the end\-to\-end product design process from user research and problem definition to wireframes, prototypes and final UI.
* Design intuitive and scalable experiences for high\-traffic B2C web and mobile products.
* Conduct user research, usability testing and competitive analysis.
* Translate customer and business requirements into effective product experiences.
* Create and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components and interaction patterns.
* Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers and Business stakeholders.
* Use product analytics, user feedback and research insights to improve existing experiences.
* Present design concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Ensure consistency across different digital products and customer journeys.
* Contribute to design strategy, product thinking and UX standards across the organization.

Required Skills

* Product Design
* UX/UI Design
* User Research
* Usability Testing
* Wireframing \& Prototyping
* Interaction Design
* Visual Design
* Design Systems
* Design Thinking
* B2C Digital Products
* Figma or equivalent design tools
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

Candidate Requirements

* 6–8 years of relevant experience in **UX/Product Design**.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **Product Design**, rather than UI/UX visual design alone.
* Experience working on **B2C digital products** with significant user traffic.
* BDes/MDes or equivalent design education preferred.
* Candidates from **IIT, NIT, NIFT or other reputed design institutions** will be preferred.
* Experience with a strong B2C product organization is preferred.
* Candidate must currently be based in **Pune or Mumbai**.
* Must be willing to work from the Pune office **5 days a week \+ alternate Saturdays**.
* Must be available for **face\-to\-face interviews in Pune**.
* Maximum notice period: **30 days**.
* Age requirement: **30–34 years**.

What You'll Work On

You will work on customer\-facing digital products where design decisions need to balance **customer experience, usability, business objectives and technical feasibility**.

The role involves working across the complete product design lifecycle, from identifying user problems through research and discovery to designing, testing and continuously improving the final experience.

Pay: ₹1,800,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

* Please share your LinkedIn profile and portfolio link. Your portfolio should include examples of end\-to\-end product design work, including problem definition, UX flows, wireframes/prototypes and final UI.

title: UX Researcher
description:
**UX Researcher**

8848 Digital LLP provides clients with high\-quality ERPNext implementations, application customizations, management consulting, and a variety of technical infrastructure services. 8848 Digital delivers enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions to mid\-market companies around the world, including custom web and mobile solutions. We are seeking a highly capable and detail\-oriented UX Researcher to join our team.

As a UX Researcher, you will play a critical role in understanding user needs, behaviors, and motivations to inform the design and development of intuitive, user\-centered products. You will collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and developers to ensure our solutions meet user expectations and deliver exceptional experiences.

**Duties and Responsibilities:** 

● Plan, execute, and manage user research activities, including usability testing, user interviews, surveys, and heuristic evaluations.

● Leverage a mix of qualitative and quantitative methods to gather user insights.

● Synthesize research findings into actionable insights, reports, and presentations.

● Create clear and compelling reports, presentations, and data visualizations to communicate findings.

● Work closely with designers, product managers, and developers to integrate research findings into product designs and strategies.

● Conduct user testing to support UX designers during prototype development and identify usability issues before product launch.

● Advocate for user\-centric approaches throughout the product development lifecycle.

● Translate research insights into practical design recommendations that improve usability and user satisfaction.

● Create visually appealing, user\-friendly, and responsive interface designs aligned with user needs and business objectives.

● Develop wireframes, user flows, mockups, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs for web and mobile applications.

● Establish and maintain design systems, reusable components, and UI guidelines to ensure consistency across products.

● Collaborate closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of UI designs and maintain design quality throughout the development process.

● Participate in design reviews and continuously improve user experiences through iterative feedback and testing.

**Qualifications and Requirements:** 

● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Design, or a related field.

● Minimum 3–5 years of experience in UX Research or a related role.

● 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in UI Design, with the ability to create visually appealing, user\-friendly, and responsive interfaces.

● Familiarity with various research methodologies such as usability testing, A/B testing, user interviews, heuristic evaluations, and survey design.

● Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch, including wireframing, mockups, design systems, prototyping, and high\-fidelity UI creation.

● Experience with research tools such as UserTesting, Optimal Workshop, Hotjar, or similar platforms.

● Strong understanding of visual design principles, including typography, color theory, spacing, layout, and accessibility standards.

● Basic understanding of responsive design principles and platform\-specific design considerations for web and mobile applications.

● Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present research findings effectively to stakeholders.

● Ability to quickly learn and understand new software, research features, and functions.

● Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities and priorities effectively.

● Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within cross\-functional teams comprising designers, developers, product managers, and business stakeholders.

Benefits:

* Health insurance

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* UX: 2 years (Required)
* UI design: 2 years (Required)

* Mumbai, Maharashtra (Required)

**Desirable**: Experience in creating interactive PDFs, digital publications or multimedia proposal documents. Experience in building or administering bid microsites, landing pages, digital sales rooms or other secure online proposal environments.
